chart.title: Have to
chart.note_rule: Use have to with I / You / We / They. Use has to with She / He.
chart.note_exception: What do you have to do? → I have to cook dinner.
chart.note_exception_detail: What does she have to do? → She has to water the garden.

tab1_samples.jp: 私は今夜、夕食を作らなければなりません。

tab1_samples.text: She has to water the garden every day.
tab1_samples.jp: 彼女は毎日、庭に水をやらなければなりません。

tab1_samples.text: We have to pick the vegetables before noon.
tab1_samples.jp: 私たちは正午前に野菜を収穫しなければなりません。

tab1_samples.text: He has to weed the garden once a week.
tab1_samples.jp: 彼は週に一度、庭の草取りをしなければなりません。

tab1_samples.text: You have to plant the seeds in a row.
tab1_samples.jp: あなたは種を一列に植えなければなりません。
彼らは今日、掘らなくてもいいです。

tab1_samples.text: She doesn't have to grow her own food.
tab1_samples.jp: 彼女は自分で食べ物を育てなくてもいいです。

tab1_samples.text: I don't have to go to the market on Fridays.
tab1_samples.jp: 私は毎週金曜日に市場へ行かなくてもいいです。

tab1_samples.text: What do you have to do in the garden?
tab1_samples.jp: 庭で何をしなければなりませんか？

tab1_samples.text: What does he have to do this morning?
tab1_samples.jp: 彼は今朝、何をしなければなりませんか？

rules.title: have to (I / You / We / They)
rules.subtitle: Use have to + base verb with I, You, We, and They.
rules.jp_subtitle: I、You、We、Theyにはhave to + 動詞の原形を使います。

transforms.to: I / You / We / They + have to + verb

examples.jp: 私は今夜、夕食を作らなければなりません。
彼らは野菜を収穫しなければなりません。

rules.title: has to (She / He)
rules.subtitle: Use has to + base verb with She and He.
rules.jp_subtitle: SheとHeにはhas to + 動詞の原形を使います。

examples.jp: 彼女は庭に水をやらなければなりません。

examples.text: He has to weed the garden once a week.
examples.jp: 彼は週に一度、草取りをしなければなりません。

rules.title: don't have to (I / You / We / They)
rules.jp_title: don't have to（I / You / We / They）
rules.subtitle: Use don't have to to say something is NOT necessary.
rules.jp_subtitle: don't have toは「〜しなくてもよい」という意味です。

transforms.to: I / You / We / They + don't have to + verb

examples.text: I don't have to go to the market today.
examples.jp: 私は今日、市場へ行かなくてもいいです。
彼らは今日、掘らなくてもいいです。

rules.title: doesn't have to (She / He)
rules.subtitle: Use doesn't have to with She and He for negative.
rules.jp_subtitle: SheとHeの否定形はdoesn't have toを使います。

examples.text: She doesn't have to grow her own food.
examples.jp: 彼女は自分で食べ物を育てなくてもいいです。

examples.text: He doesn't have to water the plants today.
examples.jp: 彼は今日、植物に水をやらなくてもいいです。

rules.title: Questions: What do / does … have to do?
rules.jp_title: 疑問文：What do / does … have to do?
rules.subtitle: Use do for I/You/We/They and does for She/He in questions.
rules.jp_subtitle: 疑問文ではI/You/We/Theyにdo、She/Heにdoesを使います。

transforms.from: What ___ you / she have to do?
transforms.to: What do you / What does she have to do?

examples.text: What do you have to do? → I have to cook dinner.
examples.jp: あなたは何をしなければなりませんか？→ 夕食を作らなければなりません。

examples.text: What does she have to do? → She has to water the garden.
examples.jp: 彼女は何をしなければなりませんか？→ 庭に水をやらなければなりません。

explanation.title: have to
explanation.body: The subject is I, so use have to.

questions.jp: 私は今夜、夕食を作らなければなりません。

explanation.title: has to
explanation.body: The subject is She, so use has to.

questions.jp: 彼女は庭に水をやらなければなりません。

explanation.title: have to
explanation.body: The subject is They, so use have to.

questions.jp: 彼らは野菜を収穫しなければなりません。

explanation.title: doesn't have to
explanation.body: The subject is He, so the negative is doesn't have to.

questions.jp: 彼は今日、草取りをしなくてもいいです。

explanation.title: don't have to
explanation.body: The subject is We, so the negative is don't have to.

questions.jp: 私たちは種を植えなくてもいいです。

explanation.title: do
explanation.body: Use do in questions with I / You / We / They.

questions.jp: あなたは何をしなければなりませんか？

explanation.title: does
explanation.body: Use does in questions with She / He.
